description: Chess engine in Rust with a Python trainer, built on the esca library.
rules: anglerfish is the engine (Rust crate anglerfish-core, binary `anglerfish`, UCI) and the trainer (Python package pyanglerfish); the chess library both use is esca, from crates.io and PyPI: https://github.com/AnglerfishChess/esca.

The trainer reads the Lichess evaluation dump with zstandard, stores each position as esca's typed fact arrays in packed safetensors shards, and fits a two-head net (value, policy) whose first layer casts those arrays; the checkpoint carries the array names and a digest of their types and shapes, which the engine checks on load.
Nothing is published from this repository yet; versions are independent of esca's.
